title: He Was 82 and Still Working at Walmart. Nobody Knew Why #truestory
description:
#truestory #kindness #veteran

"How could I get so lucky?"

Butch was 82, a Navy vet, still working 8 to 9-hour shifts at a Walmart register. A guy buying batteries asked his TikTok followers one question. What nobody in that line knew was why Butch was still working at all.
